sloka: तव सर्वम् अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय शुभ आनने ।वासम् न रोचये अरण्ये शक्तिमान् अपि रक्षणे ॥२-३०-२८॥
transliteration: tava sarvam abhiprāyam avijñāya śubha ānane ।vāsam na rocaye araṇye śaktimān api rakṣaṇe ॥2-30-28॥

translations.english: O Sita of auspicious countenance even though I am capable of protecting you I did not like your stay in the forest as I did not know your intentions.
